capabilities: search citations and open or create literature notes
insert wiki-links, markdown citations, and templated note content
import Zotero PDF annotations with zotero:// deep links
re-sync literature notes with the library via non-destructive three-way merges
load citations from multiple sources including BibTeX, CSL-JSON, Hayagriva, Readwise, and Zotero
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a detailed network-use disclosure: no telemetry, Readwise contacted only with a user-supplied token, Zotero traffic is loopback-only, and all bibliography parsing happens locally. Full documentation lives in a separate docs/ directory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search a reference library, insert formatted citations, or generate and maintain literature notes from a bibliography.

relations.evidence: read a running Zotero (7+) through its built-in local API, with no Better BibTeX, no export files
via the Better BibTeX pull-export endpoint or through Zotero's own local API
Readwise integration: import highlights and documents from Readwise as citable entries
Export your bibliography from Zotero + Better BibTeX, Mendeley, or Paperpile
Export your bibliography from Zotero + Better BibTeX, Mendeley, or Paperpile

summary: Citation plugin that searches a bibliography or a running Zotero and creates literature notes, inserts citations, and imports PDF annotations.
